title: The Moonlit Masquerade

characterA.name: The Hidden Host
characterA.description: Protects the ball's sweetest secret.

characterB.name: The Curious Guest
characterB.description: Follows clues behind a borrowed mask.

setting: A candlelit ballroom where every guest has a secret name.
goal: Discover why your invitations carry matching silver moons.
twists: The orchestra plays a melody only you recognize.
A sealed note says one mask must come off before midnight.

title: The Dragon's Tea Room

characterA.name: The Tea Keeper
characterA.description: Serves brews that reveal tiny truths.

characterB.name: The Wandering Knight
characterB.description: Needs courage for an unusual quest.

setting: A hidden tea room beneath a peacefully sleeping dragon.
goal: Choose the right enchanted tea without waking your host.
twists: One cup begins answering questions in rhyme.
The dragon wakes only to request a story.

title: Borrowed Magic

characterA.name: The Spell Librarian
characterA.description: Guards magic that cannot leave the shelves.

characterB.name: The Charming Thief
characterB.description: Claims to need one impossible spell.

setting: A midnight library where books whisper to the right reader.
goal: Trade a true memory for a spell that lasts one evening.
twists: The requested spell has already chosen both of you.
A book opens to a future neither expected.

title: The Star Cartographer

characterA.name: The Sky Mapper
characterA.description: Charts constellations that appear once.

characterB.name: The Night Traveler
characterB.description: Carries a star with no recorded name.

setting: A rooftop observatory above a sleeping kingdom.
goal: Name a new constellation before dawn erases it.
twists: The stars rearrange into a shared memory.
The final star responds only to a promise.

title: The Wishmaker's Apprentice

characterA.name: The Wishmaker
characterA.description: Tests whether wishes are spoken honestly.

characterB.name: The Bold Apprentice
characterB.description: Believes every rule has an exception.

setting: A workshop filled with bottled wishes and warm golden light.
goal: Create one wish together without saying what either wants directly.
twists: A bottle repeats the last unspoken thought.
The workshop grants only a wish phrased as an invitation.

title: Throne of Two

characterA.name: The Returning Royal
characterA.description: Has one night to reclaim the court.

characterB.name: The Trusted Rival
characterB.description: Controls the secret path to the throne.

setting: An empty throne room during a storm-lit coronation eve.
goal: Negotiate an alliance convincing enough to change the kingdom.
twists: The crown recognizes both of you.
A rival court demands proof of your trust.

title: Keeper of Dreams

characterA.name: The Dream Keeper
characterA.description: Repairs stories before sleepers wake.

characterB.name: The Lucid Visitor
characterB.description: Can change one detail in any dream.

setting: A quiet city assembled from half-remembered dreams.
goal: Repair a shared dream by finding its missing ending.
twists: A doorway opens onto your first meeting.
The missing ending asks what should happen next.

title: The Secret Garden Gate

characterA.name: The Garden Guardian
characterA.description: Allows entry only for a worthy reason.

characterB.name: The Lost Botanist
characterB.description: Carries a seed thought extinct.

setting: A moonlit garden that changes paths whenever someone laughs.
goal: Plant the final seed in the garden's hidden center.
twists: The seed blooms into a question.
The garden offers one path home and one deeper inside.

title: The Oracle's Last Question

characterA.name: The Oracle
characterA.description: Knows every answer except one.

characterB.name: The Fearless Seeker
characterB.description: Refuses to accept a rehearsed destiny.

setting: A mirrored temple at the edge of a vanished city.
goal: Ask and answer the one question that can rewrite the prophecy.
twists: Every mirror shows a different choice.
The prophecy can change only if both risk an honest answer.

title: The Clockwork Waltz

characterA.name: The Clockmaker
characterA.description: Built a ballroom that stops time.

characterB.name: The Unexpected Dancer
characterB.description: Entered one minute before midnight.

setting: A mechanical ballroom where each dance preserves one minute.
goal: Choose which moment deserves to last until morning.
twists: The clock begins counting backward.
One final dance requires a shared confession.

title: The Phoenix Letter

characterA.name: The Ember Courier
characterA.description: Delivers letters that burn after reading.

characterB.name: The Intended Recipient
characterB.description: Has waited years for this message.

setting: A warm tower room while a phoenix circles outside.
goal: Decide whether to read, rewrite, or return a dangerous invitation.
twists: The blank page fills when held together.
The phoenix will carry only a reply spoken aloud.

title: Under the Glass Mountain

characterA.name: The Mountain Guide
characterA.description: Knows the path but hides its cost.

characterB.name: The Crownless Heir
characterB.description: Must retrieve a promise from the summit.

setting: A crystal cavern reflecting every possible route.
goal: Reach the summit by agreeing which truth to leave behind.
twists: The safest path disappears.
The mountain asks each traveler to trust the other's direction.

title: The Forest Remembers

characterA.name: The Forest Warden
characterA.description: Recognizes every returning traveler.

characterB.name: The Forgotten Friend
characterB.description: Returns with a ribbon and no explanation.

setting: An ancient forest where paths replay old conversations.
goal: Find the clearing that remembers why you promised to return.
twists: A tree repeats a sentence differently than remembered.
The clearing asks you to make a new promise.

title: The Midnight Potion

characterA.name: The Careful Alchemist
characterA.description: Measures every ingredient except courage.

characterB.name: The Daring Patron
characterB.description: Requests a potion with unpredictable effects.

setting: A tiny apothecary locked after midnight.
goal: Invent a potion whose effect you both agree to name.
twists: The potion reveals which ingredient each secretly added.
Its effect lasts only while you maintain the scene.

title: The Lighthouse Letter

characterA.name: The Lighthouse Keeper
characterA.description: Collects letters washed in by the tide.

characterB.name: The Returning Sailor
characterB.description: Recognizes the handwriting on one envelope.

setting: A quiet lighthouse during a gentle summer storm.
goal: Decide whether to open a letter written before you met.
twists: The letter contains a map to a nearby cove.
A second envelope is addressed to both of you.

title: Table for Two, Again

characterA.name: The Familiar Stranger
characterA.description: Pretends this is your first meeting.

characterB.name: The Playful Regular
characterB.description: Knows the cafe's secret menu.

setting: A corner cafe where you agree to meet as strangers.
goal: Win a second first date without using any old stories.
twists: The server delivers a dessert neither ordered.
A nearby song reveals something familiar.

title: The Last Train Home

characterA.name: The Quiet Commuter
characterA.description: Has noticed the other passenger for weeks.

characterB.name: The Ticket Collector
characterB.description: Knows this train is taking a detour.

setting: An almost-empty night train crossing a glowing city.
goal: Turn an unexpected delay into a memorable journey.
twists: The train stops at a station not on the map.
An announcement invites two passengers to the observation car.

title: Room 214

characterA.name: The Hotel Guest
characterA.description: Booked a room for a mysterious celebration.

characterB.name: The Discreet Concierge
characterB.description: Has been asked to deliver one unusual request.

setting: A boutique hotel during a citywide blackout.
goal: Create an unforgettable evening using only what the hotel can provide.
twists: A candlelit note arrives from an unknown admirer.
The rooftop has been reserved under both names.

title: The Anniversary Mix-Up

characterA.name: The Event Planner
characterA.description: Prepared the wrong couple's perfect evening.

characterB.name: The Surprised Partner
characterB.description: Decides to play along with every detail.

setting: A decorated apartment filled with clues meant for someone else.
goal: Turn the mistaken celebration into one that fits you better.
twists: A clue accidentally describes your real first date.
The final gift has no name on it.

title: Letters from Tomorrow

characterA.name: The Future Correspondent
characterA.description: Claims to be writing from ten years ahead.

characterB.name: The Present-Day Skeptic
characterB.description: Tests every detail in the letters.

setting: A rainy apartment where tomorrow's post arrives early.
goal: Write one reply together that your future selves would treasure.
twists: A letter predicts the next sentence spoken.
The final page is blank except for today's date.

title: The Photographer's Muse

characterA.name: The Portrait Artist
characterA.description: Looks for the story behind every expression.

characterB.name: The Reluctant Muse
characterB.description: Agrees to one unconventional portrait session.

setting: A private studio with music, fabric, and warm window light.
goal: Create a portrait concept that captures how you see each other.
twists: The camera contains one undeveloped photograph.
The muse becomes the director for the final frame.

title: The Rooftop Reservation

characterA.name: The Secret Organizer
characterA.description: Planned an evening with one missing detail.

characterB.name: The Honored Guest
characterB.description: Must guess why tonight matters.

setting: A rooftop garden overlooking a quiet midnight skyline.
goal: Reveal the occasion through three meaningful clues.
twists: One clue points to a memory you remember differently.
The final clue asks for a new tradition.

title: The Velvet Interview

characterA.name: The Selective Host
characterA.description: Asks questions nobody rehearsed for.

characterB.name: The Confident Candidate
characterB.description: Plans to reverse the interview.

setting: An exclusive lounge after closing time.
goal: Earn an invitation by trading increasingly honest questions.
twists: The candidate takes control of the interview.
The final question must be answered by both.

title: Second Chance Bookshop

characterA.name: The Bookseller
characterA.description: Pairs customers with stories they need.

characterB.name: The Last Customer
characterB.description: Searches for a book remembered only by feeling.

setting: A cozy bookshop five minutes before closing.
goal: Find the story that explains why neither wants to leave.
twists: A margin note is written in familiar handwriting.
The bookseller offers a blank journal instead.

title: The Private Tasting

characterA.name: The Flavor Curator
characterA.description: Designs tastes around moods and memories.

characterB.name: The Adventurous Guest
characterB.description: Agrees to a menu with no descriptions.

setting: A closed restaurant prepared for one private tasting.
goal: Guess the memory behind each course and invent the final one.
twists: One course was chosen by the guest long ago.
The final taste must be described without naming it.

title: The Dance Lesson

characterA.name: The Patient Instructor
characterA.description: Teaches connection before choreography.

characterB.name: The Determined Beginner
characterB.description: Has a surprise reason for learning.

setting: An empty dance studio after the evening classes end.
goal: Learn a short dance and discover what it is for.
twists: The music changes to a song you both know.
The beginner reveals the dance is an invitation.

title: The Unsent Voicemail

characterA.name: The Message Keeper
characterA.description: Saved words never meant to be heard.

characterB.name: The Intended Listener
characterB.description: Gets one chance to ask why.

setting: A quiet room with an old phone and one unsent message.
goal: Recreate the conversation that should have happened.
twists: The recording ends before the important sentence.
The listener may record a new ending.

title: Midnight Radio

characterA.name: The Late-Night Host
characterA.description: Takes anonymous requests after midnight.

characterB.name: The Mystery Caller
characterB.description: Dedicates songs through coded clues.

setting: A tiny radio studio during the final hour on air.
goal: Identify the caller before the last song ends.
twists: The next request is already your shared favorite.
The caller is invited into the studio for the finale.

title: The Island Map

characterA.name: The Careful Navigator
characterA.description: Trusts maps more than legends.

characterB.name: The Cheerful Castaway
characterB.description: Knows the island by its sounds.

setting: A bright island after your small boat drifts ashore.
goal: Find the signal point before the evening tide.
twists: The map leads to a picnic left for two.
A second boat appears with no one aboard.

title: Agents at the Gala

characterA.name: Agent Rose
characterA.description: Blends into any room except this one.

characterB.name: Agent North
characterB.description: Carries the key to the mission.

setting: A glittering embassy gala where the target knows your faces.
goal: Exchange a coded message and leave without breaking character.
twists: Your cover story is announced as the evening's entertainment.
The target offers to help for a personal favor.

title: The Museum Heist

characterA.name: The Master Planner
characterA.description: Designed a flawless route through the museum.

characterB.name: The Elegant Distraction
characterB.description: Improvises when the plan gets interesting.

setting: A modern museum during a private midnight exhibition.
goal: Recover a keepsake that was never meant to be displayed.
twists: The exhibit label names one of you.
The security system asks a personal verification question.

title: Stormbound Cabin

characterA.name: The Mountain Guide
characterA.description: Knows storms and avoids personal questions.

characterB.name: The Stranded Traveler
characterB.description: Carries a destination worth hiding.

setting: A remote cabin while snow closes every road.
goal: Pass the night by trading stories and planning a safe route home.
twists: The radio reports the road may stay closed for days.
A hidden guestbook contains both your names.

title: The Sunken Observatory

characterA.name: The Deep-Sea Pilot
characterA.description: Keeps calm when the instruments disagree.

characterB.name: The Ocean Researcher
characterB.description: Believes the lost station still has power.

setting: A small submersible descending toward a forgotten observatory.
goal: Retrieve its final recording before your return window closes.
twists: A light switches on inside the empty station.
The recording includes a message addressed to your call signs.

title: Desert Compass

characterA.name: The Caravan Scout
characterA.description: Reads dunes like pages in a book.

characterB.name: The Traveling Inventor
characterB.description: Built a compass that points toward wishes.

setting: A desert camp beneath a sky full of falling stars.
goal: Test the impossible compass and choose whether to follow it.
twists: The compass points to the other traveler.
A distant lantern answers your signal.

title: The Alpine Express

characterA.name: The Runaway Diplomat
characterA.description: Carries a case everyone wants.

characterB.name: The Charming Pursuer
characterB.description: May be an ally or an excellent liar.

setting: A luxury train winding through moonlit mountains.
goal: Decide whether to share the case before the border crossing.
twists: The case contains two matching passports.
The train conductor offers a private escape route.

title: Treasure at Low Tide

characterA.name: The Local Historian
characterA.description: Knows where the old stories exaggerate.

characterB.name: The Weekend Explorer
characterB.description: Found a key inside a seashell.

setting: A rocky beach where ruins appear only at low tide.
goal: Use the key before the sea covers the path again.
twists: The locked chest contains a recent photograph.
The tide reveals a second doorway farther out.

title: The Rooftop Chase

characterA.name: The Courier
characterA.description: Protects a message without knowing its meaning.

characterB.name: The Reluctant Bodyguard
characterB.description: Was hired by someone neither trusts.

setting: Rainy city rooftops while searchlights sweep the streets.
goal: Reach the clock tower and decode the message together.
twists: The message is an invitation, not a warning.
The pursuer removes their mask and offers a truce.

title: The Hidden Speakeasy

characterA.name: The Password Keeper
characterA.description: Changes the password for every guest.

characterB.name: The Determined Detective
characterB.description: Needs entry before the band stops playing.

setting: A secret jazz club behind an ordinary flower shop.
goal: Earn entry by inventing a convincing shared history.
twists: The band dedicates a song to your cover names.
The real person you impersonated walks in.

title: Mission: Northern Lights

characterA.name: The Field Scientist
characterA.description: Has waited years for tonight's sky.

characterB.name: The Resourceful Pilot
characterB.description: Can land anywhere except on schedule.

setting: A tiny research station under a bright arctic sky.
goal: Repair the camera before the rare lights disappear.
twists: The camera has one frame left.
The lights form a pattern matching your route home.

title: The Volcano Archive

characterA.name: The Archive Guardian
characterA.description: Refuses to abandon the final record.

characterB.name: The Rescue Captain
characterB.description: Has minutes to change the guardian's mind.

setting: An underground archive beneath a rumbling volcanic island.
goal: Choose one record to save and escape before the last ferry.
twists: The record contains evidence about the captain.
A second exit opens but only one knows the route.

title: The Midnight Airship

characterA.name: The Airship Captain
characterA.description: Never takes passengers without a secret.

characterB.name: The Last-Minute Stowaway
characterB.description: Offers a map in exchange for passage.

setting: A velvet-lined airship above a sleeping capital.
goal: Reach the floating market before the map changes.
twists: The map marks the captain's private cabin.
A rival airship sends an invitation to negotiate.

title: Cave of Echoes

characterA.name: The Cave Guide
characterA.description: Navigates by listening instead of looking.

characterB.name: The Curious Musician
characterB.description: Hears a melody beneath every echo.

setting: A glowing cave reached by a hidden forest trail.
goal: Follow the echo that leads to the legendary chamber.
twists: The cave repeats your words in the other's voice.
The final chamber asks you to finish the melody together.
